_comment: SATS Disaster demo account config — COPY this file to tool/demo_accounts.json
and replace the placeholder emails with REAL Google account emails
(e.g. Gmail addresses) that you control. The app authenticates with
Google Sign-In ONLY, so each demo persona must be an actual Google
identity. tool/demo_accounts.json is git-ignored — never commit real
account emails you do not want public.
village_authority  → village + mandal + district all required
district_authority → district required; mandal/village empty = whole district
rescue             → mandal scope recommended; village empty = whole mandal
citizen            → village + mandal + district all required
These names MUST match the app's existing demo dataset geography

accounts.name: Demo Citizen
accounts.purpose: Primary citizen: reports the incident shown to authorities.

accounts.name: Demo Village Authority
accounts.purpose: Sees the Mukkamala incident in the village feed and triages it.

accounts.name: Demo District Authority
accounts.purpose: District-wide feed and alerts across all of East Godavari.

accounts.name: Demo Rescue Team
accounts.purpose: Mandal-scoped response: sees rescue-required incidents in Ambajipeta.
